column7: By the end of 2023, the governmental structure responsible for promoting open data and the Open Government Partnership became the Ministry of Public Administration and Anticorruption. After assuming this responsibility, the Ministry had not yet implemented substantial initiatives to actively promote the portal. However, discussions about the portal took place during meetings and consultations with various ministries and institutions. In these gatherings, both the existence of the portal and the need for its upgrades were emphasized. While direct promotional efforts remained limited at the time, awareness of the portal and its significance had begun to spread within relevant government bodies.

column7:
The Open Data portal will increase interested parties' access to the ability to download data.
The National Agency of Information Society, as the implementing authority of the opendata.gov.al portal, has appointed contact people who communicate regularly with other institutions' contact persons to ensure the increase of the datasets number. On the other hand, the agency is in close collaboration with the Prime Minister's Office, which leads the process in high level, concludes the annual reports and other documentation in OGP which are published to the opendata.gov.al. Improving Equitable Access To High Standard, Sustainable Public Services At Central And Sub-National Level Program PforR with the World Bank include the action plan and strategy to upgrade the Open Data portal and to ensure its sustainability. At this moment a link is impossible to be given since we are currently drafting the ToRs.
